content: Unified ExecuteCmd replaces RunCommand/RunChrootCommand/WriteFileInChroot. No backward compatibility. File writes via shell commands (echo/cat). Single entry point for all command execution with retry, logging, user feedback.

2026-08-12: ExecuteCmd migration complete. Deleted shell.go and files.go. Created execute.go with unified ExecuteCmd(chroot, cmd). Migrated ~152 calls across 22+ files. Added mkdir -p /etc/kernel fix. Build 3/3 binaries, go vet clean, harness 25/25.

Modules moved to packageLogic: 8021q→vlan, bridge/br_netfilter→bridge, zstd_compress→zstd, overlay→incus/podman/docker. baseModules for kernel-only modules (r8169, bonding, binfmt_misc, zsmalloc). Booster doesn't use /etc/modules.
incus-feature-vm only needs qemu-system-x86_64. incus-feature → packages: [incus-feature-vm, incus-feature-client, incus-feature-utils]; incus-feature-vm → packages: [qemu-system-x86_64].
kvm module instead of kvm-amd/kvm-intel. Alpine kernel uses generic kvm module.

2026-08-12: Code review completed. Modules moved to packageLogic. incus dependency chain implemented. baseModules for kernel-only modules. booster.go uses u.Modules for modules_force_load. Harness 25/25.
2026-08-12: incus chain verified (incus-feature → incus-feature-vm → qemu-system-x86_64 → kvm module). Need to verify activatable features: hardening, zswap, nix, TPM, secure boot.
